objective: Test a zero-parameter challenger-evidence dominance arbiter on a second untouched external cohort. The arbiter is motivated by the prior external diagnostic that micro boundary flips were the weak region, but no numeric TV threshold is learned or selected.

surrogate_signal.baseline: normalized reciprocal opening average odds AvgH/AvgD/AvgA
surrogate_signal.challenger: normalized reciprocal closing average odds AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA
surrogate_signal.raw_target: challenger argmax when different from baseline argmax
surrogate_signal.interpretation: pre-match mechanism stress only; neither opening nor closing market probabilities become football3 model inputs

projection.weak_floor: P_weak_after >= P_weak_before; otherwise exact baseline fallback

comparison.raw_projection: apply V3.2.4 projection to every opening->closing Top1 switch
comparison.gated_projection: apply exact same projection only when frozen evidence-dominance condition passes

classification.SUPPORTS_MICRO_FLIP_NOISE: gated global LL <= raw global LL; gated chronological LL nondegrade count >= raw; gated league-season LL nondegrade count >= raw; gated Top1 delta vs baseline >=0; and gated executes fewer switches than raw
classification.REFUTES_MICRO_FLIP_NOISE: gated global LL > raw global LL and either gated chronological or league-season LL nondegrade count is lower than raw

guards: No scoring on prior 3420-match external cohort
